gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.161: While locked on, scroll to aim at the head, torso, arms or legs. A head hit hurts more but is harder to land, a leg hit slows them, and an arm hit weakens their blows. To switch targets, put the new one on your crosshair and press middle mouse.
gui.jaymoskingdoms.story.hint.173: Your swing follows where you aim when locked on. Go for the head and you cut across or thrust; at the body you thrust, cut across or sweep, never chop straight down; at the arms you chop down or cut across. Axes, picks, shovels and hoes only swing like weapons when you're locked on.
